jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Landscape Humanity Handbook daily illustration in fine brown ink and luminous natural watercolour on ivory paper, consistent with Image 1. Late autumn, wooded limestone northern Iberian valley. Image 1 supplies ONLY original modern traveller IDENTITY AND STYLE; do NOT copy its old lean-to, near-naked outfit or tool stock. Image 2 supplies ONLY current DATED CLOTHING. Same lean ordinary adult around thirty, dark wavy ear-length hair, short beard, natural two arms and legs and capable hands, no invented scars or tattoos.
COMPLETE OUTFIT: plain grey-brown rabbit crown with tan hair-in fox side/ear/nape extension, no animal ears, face, muzzle or hood; one worn dull TAN hair-in body wrap over BOTH shoulders, sleeveless, overlapping front and irregular above-knee hem, small old LEFT shoulder repair, chest tie below throat and narrow waist/hip keeper. Fox panel is entirely in cap, NO fox shoulder strip. Old grass torso screens stored and absent; waist underlayers concealed. BOTH feet completely enclosed in LOW PALE-TAN rabbit-skin covers with grass/hair inward and original woven BAST SOLES below/outside, visible woven margins and low bindings. Toes and heels CLOSED, tops just above ankles; bare lower legs, no leggings, tall boots, new cloak or sleeves. This exact outfit persists in all five scenes.
One actual chosen moment, no collage or diagram. No text, labels, border or watermark. No new skin supply, metal, bow, modern furniture, chimney, kiln or extra pot. Use neutral cropped natural setting, not a new camp survey. Never restore the abandoned lean-to or depict combustion under an overhang. 
Chosen moment: at the separate animal-material work spot, he gently shapes ONE small narrow tan-brown deer-skin margin around ONE smooth little wooden sliver, with a loose bark-cord tie nearby. The ENTIRE small piece is destined for a flint-edge cover; it is not a whole hide, leg wrap, cloak or new clothing. No blood or raw tissue. Show the little work held between two natural hands while seated on a low natural rock, complete body including both correctly enclosed feet. A small simple removable stick support can be at one side, with the item about to rest under protection to dry. Neutral dry woodland/rock backdrop, NO shelter, food rack, hearth, extra skin or blade inserted yet. No elaborate workbench, giant wood former or sewing machine-like action. The small unfinished guard is not yet used for carrying. Natural anatomy and uncluttered readable action.
